The '''S-3P5 Labor Droid''' was a model of [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droid]] that was used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] at [[Sobrik Spaceport]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The S-3P5 Labor Droid appears a friendly NPC in the Bounty Hunter class mission "Meeting the Admiral" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
